name: r-landfill-b
prompt: A locked-off medium close-up at a landfill under an overcast grey sky, a yellow excavator and the heaps softly out of focus behind. A man in his sixties with grey hair, his glasses pushed up on his head and a moustache, in a light blue checked shirt, holds a tablet against his chest with its back to the camera and keeps looking to the left of the frame at the officer who has just signed, his face in three-quarter profile the whole time. He nods once and says firmly, in a natural Indian English accent: "All four signatures. It's on record." His lips shape every word in time with his voice; natural blinks; he never turns his head towards the camera and never looks into the lens. Photorealistic cinematic footage, natural skin, sharp focus on his face. Audio: his voice clear, wind over open ground, a distant excavator, no music, no other voices.
